newsitem.title: ITALY: CSFB reiterates buy on Italy's Espresso.
newsitem.headline: CSFB reiterates buy on Italy's Espresso.

text.p: CS First Boston said it reiterated its "buy" recommendation on Italian media publisher Espresso and raised its target price to 7,400 lire from a previous 5,800.

CSFB equity strategist Andrea Azzimondi said in a report the macro scenario looks favourable for the publisher. It said Espresso's stock has performed well since December, and "we believe that Espresso's margin expansion should continue in 1997 and 1998."

The report said the merger between Editoriale L'Espresso and its La Repubblica unit, announced earlier this year, should simplify the structure. Espresso is controlled by Carlo De Benedetti's industrial holding company CIR.
"We view favourably the merger since it aligns the shareholders' interests in the companies and eliminates the arbitrage opportunities between the two," CSFB said.
The Espresso group posted 1996 consolidated net profit of 29.4 billion lire against 12.5 billion in 1995. La Repubblica consolidated net profit was 20.2 billion lire against 2.4 billion previously.
"Based on a European publishing media map, we believe that the target price (for Espresso) should be in the 8,000 to 10,000 lire region," the report said.
At 1045 GMT, Espresso stock was 0.82 percent up at 6,150 lire on a generally easier Milan stock market.
